lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical high-contrast lines. Spacing is irregular, with narrower gaps in the posterior region and wider gaps in the central torso area.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the third vertical line from the anterior, splitting near the dorsal ridge. A second bifurcation occurs on the tenth line in the upper-mid torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first two anterior lines and the third line show termination points at approximately 40% of the torso height from the dorsal ridge. Several posterior lines appear as dashed or segmented towards the lower flank.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6 white spots is visible on the lateral posterior flank, centered above the upper hind limb joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the mid-posterior haunch are aligned horizontally, while three spots on the lower haunch form a slight diagonal line downward toward the knee.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a straight, upwards-backwards trajectory at approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the skull, with minimal lyrate curvature.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 0.8 times the width between the horn bases.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white V-shaped chevron is visible between the eyes, and two distinct white spots are present on the cheek area below the orbit.
